name: Intercom (Fin)
summary: Customer service platform with Fin, the vendor's AI customer agent, which answers and resolves customer conversations without a person and reports a resolution rate. For agents, the vendor publishes a hosted MCP server at mcp.intercom.com (US) and mcp.eu.intercom.com (EU) over the workspace's data, authorized by OAuth, and a Fin Agent API by which another agent calls Fin to answer, run a procedure or escalate; access to that API is by request. Measured: MCP initialize and the REST API answer 401 with no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 06:03Z, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.intercom.com/mcp answers 401, Bearer realm OAuth, invalid_token; api.intercom.io answers 401 missing_authorization. Vendor: authenticated remote MCP; REST and Fin Agent API by access token; Fin Agent API access on request.

jobs.summary: Fin, the vendor's words on this page: "industry leading resolution rates, averaging 76% across 12,000+ customers"; "Fin updates accounts, processes payments and refunds, troubleshoots technical issues"; "works 24 hours a day, every day". "From $0.99 per Fin outcome" (pricing page). Not measured.
